## W23 Day 30 recommendation and decision

W23   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: each decision dimension cites its evidence; the recommendation has been independently challenged; and the sponsor and accountable owner have signed the exact next scope or stop disposition.

Source basis: [GRC Workbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) · [Slow AI Kitchen](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen)

| **Decision dimension** | **Evidence and result** |
| --- | --- |
| Quality and business value | W13, W16, W17 __________________ |
| Authorization and mandatory controls | W04 to W10 __________________ |
| Competence and usable oversight | W04, W22 __________________ |
| Fallback change and incident readiness | W19 to W21 __________________ |
| Continuing ownership and resources | W24 __________________ |

**Recommendation and evidence limitations**

Expand only the specified scope; revise and retest; or stop. Explain alternatives, dissent and remaining uncertainty.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Conditions and residual risk**

Owner, deadline, evidence needed, restrictions before closure and risk acceptance authority.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Exact next scope or stop disposition**

Users, data, tools, workflow, task/operating tiers, start/end, review trigger and retraction conditions.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Consultant recommendation/date __________  Independent challenge/date __________

Sponsor decision/date __________  Accountable owner/date __________  W10 reference __________

This organizational decision is separate from W13 task release and from acceptance of the consultant's deliverables. Failed mandatory conditions block expansion regardless of benefit. Completing 30 days does not establish certification or enterprise-wide readiness.
